title: strengthening corporate governance: military experience on boards and audit quality in earnings management
core_idea: This study investigates how military experience among board members and external audit quality interact to influence accrual-based and real earnings management in non-financial firms listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange (2010–2022), framed within upper echelons theory and the monitoring role of directors.
tldr: Examines the role of military-affiliated board directors and audit quality as interacting governance mechanisms affecting accrual and real earnings management in Pakistani non-financial firms (2010–2022).
